index_record.dataset_generation_caption: The figure consists of two main components labeled (a) and (b), arranged side by side horizontally. Component (a) displays a square consistency matrix with four rows and four columns, corresponding to variables W, X, Y, and Z. The top row and leftmost column serve as headers, listing these variables. The diagonal entries are marked with a dash ('–'), indicating no self-consistency measure. The off-diagonal entries are numerical values between 0 and 1, representing pairwise consistency scores. Notably, certain values are bolded: 0.7 (W-X), 0.8 (W-Y), 0.9 (X-Y), 0.8 (Z-X), and 0.7 (Y-Z). These bolded values correspond to edges that maximize consistency, as stated in the caption. The matrix is rendered in black text on a white background, with no additional colors or shapes. Component (b) presents a semi-complete partially directed graph with four nodes labeled W, X, Y, and Z, arranged in a diamond-like configuration: W at the top, X at the bottom right, Y at the bottom left, and Z at the top left. Directed edges (arrows) connect the nodes: an arrow from Z to W, from W to X, from X to Y, and from Y to Z. Additionally, there is a diagonal arrow from Z to X and another from W to Y, forming a cross pattern within the diamond. All arrows are solid black lines with standard arrowheads, indicating directionality. The graph is drawn with simple black lines and node labels in plain text. The connection between (a) and (b) is established through the bolded values in the matrix, which directly correspond to the presence of directed edges in the graph. For example, the bold 0.7 in the W-X position corresponds to the edge from W to X, and the bold 0.8 in the Z-X position corresponds to the edge from Z to X. The figure’s caption clarifies that (a) is a consistency matrix for a semi-complete partially directed graph, where bold values indicate edges maximizing consistency, and (b) is the resulting graph structure derived from those selected edges. The layout is clean and minimalistic, using only black text and lines on a white background, with no shading, gradients, or additional visual embellishments.
